result_text:
`AGUIAdapter.dump_messages` now keeps the original order of a `ModelRequest`'s parts, so a `ToolMessage` is no longer pushed away from its tool call by user content.

The change is in `_dump_request_parts` in `pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/ui/ag_ui/_adapter.py`. Consecutive user content stays grouped into one `UserMessage`. That group is emitted, at its original position, just before a `ToolMessage` (from a `ToolReturnPart` or from a `RetryPromptPart` with a `tool_name`) or before an `UploadedFile` `ActivityMessage`. User content after such a message starts a new `UserMessage`, and the single-text-item simplification to a plain string still applies. All `SystemPromptPart`s are still combined into one `SystemMessage` emitted first.

I added two tests to `tests/test_ag_ui.py`, one for each example in your description. Both pass, and so does the rest of that file (130 tests). I didn't run lint, typecheck or the wider suite, and I didn't touch the docs.
